'''Barazon''' was an ancient [[City/Legends|city]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rhen Var/Legends|Rhen Var]]. It consisted of several arched structures sprawled across the frozen tundra.

==Behind the scenes==
It is a playable multiplayer map in the 2002 [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]].
